excerpt: The concentration in Data Journalism at DePaul focuses on reporting stories through data and non-linear storytelling. It enables students to cover many of our major social problems---crime, poverty, access to health care, homelessness, and various forms of abuse---through social science reporting, data mining and visualization. The concentration's objectives are to find and report important stories by integrating classic journalistic values of fairness, balance and impartiality with the values of digitalization and open-source culture. Graduates will be prepared to find jobs in the rapidly growing marketplace of publications that combine journalism and cutting-edge technology. Students are required to take both of the following: Choose two from the following list: - JOUR 504 MULTIMEDIA NEWS PRODUCTION - JOUR 522 MULTI-PLATFORM NEWS EDITING - JOUR 529 ONLINE NEWS BUREAU - JOUR 533 JOURNALISM & FREEDOM OF INFORMATION - JOUR 542 SOCIAL MEDIA AND THE NEWS - CSC 401 INTRODUCTION TO PROGRAMMING - CSC 423 DATA ANALYSIS AND REGRESSION - CSC 455 DATABASE PROCESSING FOR LARGE-SCALE ANALYTICS - CSC 465 DATA VISUALIZATION - CSC 495 SOCIAL NETWORK ANALYSIS - IT 403 STATISTICS AND DATA ANALYSIS
